name: looi-native
description: Looi native app (Android + iOS) — Capacitor shell around the Looi web client with background checks and local notifications.

scripts.web: cd .. && npm run build && cd native && node scripts/sync-web.mjs
scripts.sync: npm run web && npx cap sync
scripts.android:add: npx cap add android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs
scripts.android:apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && echo APK: android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
scripts.android:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
